# Theoretical and Experimental Psychology

> > A peer-reviewed, open-access scientific journal of psychology published by the Federal Research Center for Psychological and Interdisciplinary Research (PI RAE), featuring research in theoretical and experimental psychology since 1912.

Theoretical and Experimental Psychology (ISSN 2073-0861, eISSN 2782-5396) is an official publication of the Institute of Psychology at the Russian Academy of Sciences, committed to open access publishing and international indexing in VAK, RINC, and other databases. The journal operates under Budapest Open Access Initiative principles and Creative Commons licensing.
